title: Attach an ordinary discussion to a whole review slide
preconditions: Open a review with at least two slides and no existing discussion on slide A.

steps.action: Use slide A's Add comment control and submit a distinct body.
steps.expected_result: The comment is associated with slide A rather than slide B or an unrelated Item.

steps.action: Reload and open slide A discussion.
steps.expected_result: The same comment is visible in slide A context.

expected_result: The same comment is visible in slide A context.
